name: x_bot
description: X_BOT — AI Multilingual Content Generation Engine for X (Twitter)

scripts.build: node -e "import('fs').then(async fs => { const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(d + '/' + e.name) : (e.name.endsWith('.js') ? [d + '/' + e.name] : [])); for (const f of walk('src')) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Build check passed: all src/*.js modules valid.'); })"
scripts.lint: node -e "import('fs').then(async fs => { const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const walk = d => fs.readdirSync(d, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap(e => e.isDirectory() ? walk(d + '/' + e.name) : (e.name.endsWith('.js') ? [d + '/' + e.name] : [])); for (const f of walk('src')) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Lint check passed: zero syntax errors.'); })"
scripts.send:template: node --dns-result-order=ipv4first -e "import('./src/whatsapp/client.js').then(m => m.whatsappClient.sendTemplate(process.env.OWNER_PHONE_NUMBER)).then(r => console.log('✓ Template Result:', r)).catch(e => console.error('✕ Template Error:', e.message))"
